description: Documentation of the static data files served at /data/. This file describes the JSON; it is not a bank term. null means the value is not published or was not found on the cited page. It never means zero.
ordering: banks[] is alphabetical by bank_name. The order is not a ranking.
neutrality: Published terms, plus non-public Luminor and Bigbank LTV rules labelled as industry insider information. No score, no best label, no eligibility judgement.

meta.license: CC BY 4.0 proposed for the compilation; facts belong to the cited sources
meta.field_format: Each leaf field is an object

field_object.value: string | number | boolean | array | object | null
field_object.note: string or null. 'Derived' or 'Computed' means Kodulaen arithmetic from figures the bank published.
field_object.source: URL, or a non-URL provenance sentence, or null

non_url_source.meaning: industry insider information, not published by the bank. Do not present these as the bank's published terms.

current.source: Information from a former member of Luminor's housing loan team (not publicly published by Luminor), 2026-11-09
Information from Sander Seppik, a former member of Bigbank's housing loan team (insider information, not published on Bigbank's website), 2026-11-09

fields.product_url_en: Bank housing-loan page in English, or null
fields.margin: 'individual' when the bank does not publish a single margin
fields.promo_rates: Time-limited offers, with the dates the bank states
fields.max_ltv_pct: Maximum loan-to-value without the EIS guarantee. Note says Derived when computed from the down payment
fields.max_ltv_with_eis_pct: Maximum loan-to-value with the EIS guarantee
fields.usual_max_ltv_pct: Optional. Usual maximum LTV when it is stated separately from the published or derived max_ltv_pct. Absent on banks that have not reported one.
fields.regional_ltv_rules: Region effect on LTV. Either null, a short statement, or an object with outside_harju_and_tartu_county and harju_and_tartu_county (each an object of max_ltv_pct and max_ltv_with_eis_pct, or null).
fields.property_condition_ltv: Optional. How the condition of the property can change LTV. Absent when not reported.
fields.construction_ltv_stages: Optional list of construction-loan stages. Each item has stage, max_ltv_pct, and optionally basis, condition, and qualifier (usually). Absent when not reported.
fields.eis_participation: Bank offers the EIS housing-loan guarantee
fields.eis_programs: Target-group codes the bank names, or null if the bank does not itemise them. Codes: young_family, young_specialist, energy_efficient, large_family, veteran, returned_dwelling_tenant, rural
fields.eis_rural: EIS rural housing-loan guarantee, from the EIS page
fields.worked_example: The bank's published representative example. Kodulaen does not change these numbers. Leaf fields use the same value/note/source/checked object. Keys: loan_amount_eur, term_months, rate_type, margin_pct, euribor_pct, euribor_date, nominal_rate_pct, apr_pct, contract_fee_eur, monthly_payment_eur, total_repayments_eur, total_payable_eur, total_cost_of_credit_eur, example_date
fields.illustrative_example: Kodulaen's same-rate illustration, not a bank offer. Added when the site is built from data/euribor.json, so the 6-month Euribor, nominal rate and monthly payment follow the weekday Euribor update. Uniform inputs for every bank: margin_pct 2.0 (assumed, not a bank margin), euribor_tenor 6M, loan_amount_eur 100000, term_months 360, repayment_type annuity. fees_included is false. bank_published_contract_fee copies that bank's published contract_fee and may differ. margin_assumption states that the 2.0% margin is only for equal-terms comparison.
fields.digital_application: How to apply online, as the bank describes it
fields.account_requirement: Whether a current account at the bank is required

banks.csv.updated_field: checked column, one row per bank
banks.csv.shape: One row per bank. Each JSON field becomes <field>, <field>__note, <field>__source. Worked-example keys are prefixed example_. Lists are joined with ' | '. Objects are JSON text.

euribor.json.updated_field: updated (YYYY-MM-DD of the fetch). fetched_at is the full timestamp.

sources.json.updated_field: meta.updated and each section's checked date
